what: float64 second-order operators of deep tanh MLPs u(x) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 x + b_1) ...) + bo at B points: forward = operator values; vg = 0.5 mean (Op u - f)^2 and its gradient w.r.t. every weight, bias and readout parameter. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_laplacian.projected_deep_laplacian: the forward Laplacian seeded with k = min(rank, H) columns F, F F^T = W_1 S S^T W_1^T (Cholesky of the Gram matrix, Householder-QR fallback; exact values and parameter gradients) instead of the D input directions or r diffusion columns. Cells with D <= H are controls where the projection cannot reduce anything
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 40)) vs a 50-digit oracle (second-order Taylor series along every coordinate direction, diffusion column and drift, no projection; loss derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions): values and loss 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.forward_laplacian_full_seed: the same forward-Laplacian recursion seeded with all D input directions, or with the r diffusion columns W_1 S as in operator factorisation (equal to collapsed Taylor mode for these operators); omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian; folx.forward_laplacian
tiers.taylor_mode: jax.experimental.jet, one second-order jet per input direction or diffusion column, started at the first pre-activation
tiers.nested_autodiff: trace of jax.hessian and jax.grad per point (D <= 1024)

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
